title: File:NiCd VARTA battery leakage on circuit board (IMG 3313).jpg
author: John R. Southern
description: A nickel–cadmium VARTA barrel battery that has leaked onto the mainboard of a Korg Poly-61, causing massive corrosion to circuit board traces and legs of integrated circuits.
notes: Macro, oblique. Leaked VARTA NiCd barrel cell (upper centre/right) with rust-brown residue on its tab; bright blue/turquoise crystalline corrosion deposits on the pins of the HD14503BP DIP IC (lower left); green-white crust along traces and around the white header pins (centre) and resistor leads (bottom). Strong, unambiguous positive.

title: File:PCB corrosion.jpg
author: Binarysequence
description: Severe PCB corrosion from a leaky PCB mounted Ni-Cd battery
notes: Macro, oblique, shallow depth of field. Green/turquoise powdery corrosion on the legs of the SN74LS145N (centre) and on the contacts of the IC sockets (top, upper right); rust-brown flakes and dark residue on the battery footprint 'B1' (bottom centre); green staining on resistor leads (right). Strong positive with heavy coverage.

title: File:Polysix Battery corroded KLM367A board n.jpg
author: Untergeek
description: Leaking Polysix battery having corroded PCB traces on the KLM-367 board
notes: Portrait, oblique phone shot of a Korg Polysix KLM-367 board. Damage is localized: dark grey/black eaten-away traces and silvery residue running from the green leaked NiCd cell (centre right) towards the board edge (right, mid-height); brown/purple stain on the cell face. Rest of the board (DIP ICs in blue sockets) is clean, so this is a good localization test. No green crystalline deposits.

title: File:Motherboard Battery Corrosion.jpg
author: Oligopolism
description: Battery corrosion from leaking battery on old motherboard.
notes: Two sections of an old 386 motherboard on white background. Blue-green crusty corrosion along the left edge of the right-hand board (vertical band, upper-left to lower-left of that section) and around the external-battery header area (JP2/'EXT BATTERY', centre of left section, with green residue on the board and at the DIN connector). Large clean white background areas should be ignored.

title: File:Acorn Archimedes A3000 Main PCB.jpg
author: Binarysequence
description: Acorn Archimedes A3000 Main PCB.
notes: Full-board overview (not macro). Corrosion confined to the lower-left quadrant around the battery holder B1: dark/green stains, corroded resistor leads and socket pins near IC4/SK7/keyboard header. The rest of the board is clean, making this a localization / low-coverage test; corrosion occupies only ~3-5% of the frame.

title: File:Corroded contact pads on a HDD controller PCB IMG 2283.JPG
author: Hans Haase
description: Corroded contact pads on a HDD controller PCB
notes: Subtle / hard positive. WD HDD controller PCB on yellow background. Corrosion is mild oxidation only: brown-purple iridescent tarnish on the exposed copper rings around mounting holes MH1 (upper right) and the bottom-centre hole, and slight amber tint on a few J1 contact pads (upper left, near C36). No crystalline deposits. Also contains fine-pitch QFP-128 (U5) and TSOP (U2) that should NOT be flagged.

title: File:Knopfzellenakku.rechts.auf.gedruckter.Schaltung.jpg
author: Bautsch
description: Gealterter 1,2-Volt-Knopfzellenakku mit grüner Schutzhülle zur Energiepufferung auf einer gedruckten Schaltung (rechts)
notes: Side-view macro of a PCB edge. Grey-white crusty deposits on the solder tab of an aged green NiCd button cell (right) where it meets the board, with slight discoloration of the board under the tab. Corrosion is mostly on the battery terminal rather than on traces; through-hole resistors/transistor on the left are clean. Medium-strength positive.

title: File:Xilinx Spartan XC2S100.jpg
author: Phiarc
description: Xilinx Spartan-II XC2S100 FPGA in a TQFP-144 package with 92 I/O pins.
notes: Top-down, evenly lit, very sharp. Xilinx XC2S100 in TQFP-144 (0.5 mm pitch): 36 gull-wing leads per side, all four rows fully visible with clean, regular gaps. No bridges. Ideal reference for lead-gap / bridge detection.

title: File:Logitech Harmony 300 - board - Microchip PIC18F67J50-41368.jpg
author: Raimond Spekking
description: Logitech Harmony 300 - board - Microchip PIC18F67J50.
notes: Top-down macro. Microchip PIC18F67J50 in TQFP-64 with visible solder fillets on each lead; a few lint fibres lie across the right-hand lead row (could be a false bridge for naive thresholding); yellow paint dots on package body. No real bridges.

title: File:IDT 74FCT162244ATPA-4532.jpg
author: Raimond Spekking
description: IDT 74FCT162244ATPA - Fast CMOS 16-bit buffer/line driver.
notes: Top-down macro. IDT 74FCT162244 in TSSOP-48: two long rows of 24 leads, sharp, with dust specks on the package. Regular gaps, no bridges. Good for row-wise gap profiling.

title: File:SMD circuit on a wave soldered PCB.JPG
author: wdwd
description: SMD IC (SO package) fitted on the bottom side of a wave-soldered printed circuit board with two spade-shape “solder thief” pads on the left side to capture excess solder and provide clean separation.
notes: Top-down. Fine-pitch HSOP power IC with exposed heat slug on the wave-soldered bottom side of a board, with two spade-shaped solder-thief pads at the trailing end of each row (left) designed to prevent bridging. Copper-coloured pad areas between leads; no visible bridges. Good negative / pattern test.

title: File:Arduino ftdi chip-1.jpg
author: DustyDingo
description: A SMD (surface-mount device) FTDI chip, on the Arduino NG board from arduino.cc.
notes: Oblique macro on a blue Arduino PCB. FTDI chip in SSOP-28 (0.65 mm pitch); front lead row in sharp focus with shiny solder, back row soft. 0603 resistors and SMD LEDs in foreground. Specular highlights on leads. No bridges.

title: File:Realtek RTL8201BL - 01.jpg
author: Jakub T. Jankiewicz
description: ASUS motherboard macro with Realtek chip as main subject
notes: Same board area as fine_pitch_07 (angle B). Realtek RTL8201BL LQFP-48 on an ASUS motherboard, oblique view, landscape framing; crystal (centre) and unpopulated BGA footprint (lower left) also visible. Shallow depth of field. No bridges. Use with angle B for viewpoint/lighting robustness.

title: File:Realtek RTL8201BL - 02.jpg
author: Jakub T. Jankiewicz
description: ASUS motherboard macro with Realtek chip as main subject
notes: Same board area as fine_pitch_06 (angle A), shot from a different angle, rotation and crop (portrait). Realtek LQFP-48 upper left, TXC crystal centre, BGA footprint bottom. Genuine same-region / different-viewpoint pair for registration tests.

title: File:Lötbrücke.jpg
author: Hutschi
description: Lötbrücke
notes: Only genuine solder-bridge photo found with a usable licence. Low resolution (497x286). A tinned bar of solder bridges two pads (upper left/centre) on a through-hole board, above three round pads. Not fine-pitch IC leads, so treat as a coarse bridge example only.

title: File:Electronics PCB circuit board 008 (51132995110).jpg
author: Jan Helebrant
description: microphoto of some electronics circuit board (I think it is from some smartphone) photo taken with a digital microscope
notes: Digital-microscope view of a smartphone-style board: 3-terminal SMD transistor/regulator (centre), 0402/0603 passives, clean solder. STRONG specular glare: a blown-out metal shield/component at lower left (~10% of pixels saturated) plus bright terminations. Some lint fibres. No damage; glare false-positive test.

title: File:Electronics PCB circuit board 012 (51132094333).jpg
author: Jan Helebrant
description: microphoto of some electronics circuit board (I think it is from some smartphone) photo taken with a digital microscope
notes: Digital-microscope view: MSOP-10 package (left) with 5 leads per side on pads, 0402 passives (right), green solder mask with dark copper pours. Specular spots on vias/pads (~3.6% saturated). Clean and undamaged; lint fibres present.

title: File:Fritz!Box Fon WLAN 7270 v3 Details 2012-10-14-0778.jpg
author: Slick
description: Detailaufnahme von Komponenten einer AVM Fritz!Box Fon WLAN 7270 v3
notes: Top-down macro of an AVM Fritz!Box board: Infineon PSB80PGP LQFP-48 (centre), row of 0402 passives (bottom), power inductors (right). Bright specular highlights on solder terminations. Clean, undamaged; also usable as a fine-pitch negative.

title: File:Many different SMD capacitors.jpg
author: Phiarc
description: At least five different sizes of SMD capacitors on a PCB
notes: High-magnification macro of MLCC capacitors (C1125, C1128, C1142...) on green solder mask. Terminations show dark grey/greenish mottling and pinkish specular reflections that could be mistaken for corrosion: deliberate false-positive trap. No actual damage.

title: File:Filled vias.jpg
author: Phiarc
description: Filled vias on a circuit board.
notes: Focus-stacked macro with a 1 mm scale bar burned in (bottom). MLCCs, resistor, SMD LED, gold-plated contact (top left). Tiny white flux/residue flecks at a few terminations (top centre, right) and bright metallic glare on terminations. Clean board; white flecks are a false-positive trap, not corrosion.

title: File:Two JRC RC4580 dual op amps on a sound card PCB (144128909).jpg
author: Samtoucan
description: Two JRC 4580 dual op amps on a surface-mount PCB.
notes: Macro on black solder mask: two JRC 4580 op-amps in SOIC-8 with 0603/1206 passives. Shiny solder fillets with specular highlights; green out-of-focus capacitor sleeves at left edge. Clean, undamaged. 500px import, CC BY-SA 3.0.

title: File:Macro photograph of the RP2350 microcontroller on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 board.jpg
author: Profpcde
description: A macro photograph focusing on the black, square RP2350 microcontroller chip soldered onto the green circuit board of a Raspberry Pi Pico 2.
notes: Oblique macro of a Raspberry Pi Pico 2: RP2350 QFN-60 (centre), crystal, inductor, 0402 passives, gold castellated edge pads on a red background. New, clean board; low glare. Good generic negative.

title: File:2021111403 Detail Festplattenplatine Western Digital 40 GB 2021.jpg
author: VSchagow
description: Western Digital Festplattendetail Leiterbahnen, 40 GB-Festplatte, IDE
notes: Oblique macro of a WD hard-disk PCB: green solder mask, traces, vias, solder-filled test points (E5-E66 labels) with matte grey surface, plated through-holes (centre). Clean, undamaged; traces and silkscreen only, no components.
